podcast.title: Diverse Career
podcast.body: Shel Silverstein had an incredibly diverse career, publishing and illustrating *The Giving Tree*, drawing numerous cartoons for *Playboy* magazine, writing hit songs like "A Boy Named Sue," and authoring "Where the Sidewalk Ends." "I cannot think of too many writers who had a career as diverse as shell silverstein."

srcs.episode: Ep. 44 - Streaking, Werewolves, Sharks, & Drinking - 70s Novelty Songs

podcast.title: Pirate-like Appearance
podcast.body: Silverstein was known for his distinctive appearance, which included an eye patch due to an accident, making him look somewhat like a pirate. He even lived on a houseboat for a period. "He kind of looked like a pirate in race lawyer who wore an eye patch because of an accident that damaged his eye."

podcast.title: Writer for Dr. Hook
podcast.body: He served as the primary writer for Dr. Hook & The Medicine Show. "He was also the writer for dr hook in the medicine show."
